name: Mirumira Garanzu
source:
A knight princess who is hiding her lineage, and is a member of the Guild Alliance. Her breasts are known as the best there is, which gathers the stares of men. Because of her body, most women adventurers are jealous of her, and so she feels a strong bond with Ashley who is in the same circumstances as her. She can fight with a sword, but she's better at magic. 

[Translated from [url=http://noblecat-soft.com/himekishiinmon/index.html#chal]Official Site[/url]]
